Name: Cut Characters (Alpha)
Author: YenaLoomer
Description:
Meet some cut characters from Stardew Valley. Some were cut from Stardew, some from other peoples mods, some I created myself. I hope you enjoy them all!

If you like my mod please endorse it. There is now a Discord Server where you can get all the latest news and updates - [url=https://discord.gg/DbmyJwtjDh]Discord Server

[/url](NOTE: This mod is still in the Alpha stages. Fall and Winter Schedules/Sprites/etc are not yet implemented. Any errors reported for those seasons will be ignored)﻿

[b]Bebsi
[/b]Proud owner of Bebsi Cola. You can find her in Mineral Town on Sunday's and Monday's (If you have Rexstrife's Mineral Town installed), or Tuesday, Wednesday and Saturday in Pelican Town.

Loves - Bebsi Cola (only if Mineral Town in installed)
Likes - Bebsi products
Hates - trash

[b]Candi
[/b]Mother of Darla, Wife of Tobias. Candi spends her time working away on her computer or sewing her clothes for Darla. She's a hard working no nonsense kinda gal.

Loves - Elvish Jewelry, Beer, Energy Tonics
Likes - Wine, Strawberries
Dislikes - gem items, mineral items, flower items, forged items
Hates - trash

[b]Dana[/b]
Daughter to Pam, sister to Penny. Dana is a Zuzu University Student and hasn't been in contact with her family in quite awhile. She means well but Pam's habits have made her distant herself quite a bit.

Hates - trash

[b]Darla[/b]
Daughter to Candi and Tobias. Darla acts innocent but she's a real bully behind the scenes. Especially to Vincent who is the center of Darla's attention. She does get along alright with Jas, but tends to be jealous of how much time Vincent spends with her.

Loves - Magic Rock Candy, Cranberry Candy
Hates - trash, anything fish


[b]Dobson[/b]
Assistant Manager under Morris for JojaMart. You can find him hanging out with his good buddy Morris most of the time before the work day begins (if SVE is installed). Then during his work shift you can find him walking around JojaMarts interior. He prefers the supervising role, but on occasion you can find him working behind the counter.

Loves - Sashimi, Maki Roll, Coffee Bean, Caviar, and Green Tea
Likes - Joja Cola and Salmon Dinner
Dislikes - Eggplant
Hates - Any item from the mineral category, gem category, any item from the trash category and all foraged items
Neutral - Diamond and Prismatic Shard

[b]Dwarf King[/b]
The King of all Dwarves! Which he'll do his best to remind you of constantly. Don't let him convince you to drink silk worm milk. It's not very tasty.

Loves - Prismatic Shard, Lava Eel
Likes - Cave Carrot, Fire Quartz, Omni Geode
Hates- Trash

[b]Lady[/b]
Lady lives in Zuzu but frequents Pelican Town daily. She is also Dobson's sweet old grandmother. Unlike Dobson, Lady is quite the social butterfly. She visits many of the residents of Pelican Town daily. (She is heavily influenced by the game Little Misfortune. So expect a lot of references to that).

Loves - Ancient Doll, and both types of Strange Dolls.
Likes - Strange Bun, Glazed Yams, Pink Cake, Ice Cream and Green Tea
Dislikes - Joja Cola, Rice Pudding and Hot Pepper
Hates - All items from the mineral and trash category
Neutral - any item from the fish category, Cookies, Yam, Beet, Stone and Tea Leaves

[b]Tobias[/b]
Husband to Candi, father to Darla. He's not the sharpest tool in the shed and often uses slanged words. But his heart is in the right place. His naivety allows others to take him for granted unfortunately. But to make up for it he's as strong as an ox.

Loves - Hashbrowns, Muscle Remedy
Likes - Potatoes, Lobster, Crab
Dislikes - Broccoli
Hates - trash, Beer

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]

[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14493]MEEP[/url]﻿ (Optional)

[b][u]How to unlock characters[/u]

Dobson
[/b]- See Dobson's intro cutscene at the bus stop then wait until the next day

[b]Lady[/b]
- Fix the bus to unlock Lady

[b]Bebsi[/b]
- See Dobson's 2 heart event

[b]Candi, Darla, Tobias[/b]
- Enter the new trailer and watch the event then wait until the next day

[b]Dwarf King[/b]
- Destroy the boulder blocking the way to the Dwarf, talk to Dwarf and come back the next day (also requires the Dwarf Language to actually understand him)

[b]Dana[/b]
- Have both the bus fixed and must have seen Penny's 4 heart event

[spoiler][b]Gristle[/b][/spoiler]
- Visit the Witch's Hut

[spoiler][b]Krobeth[/b][/spoiler]
- See Krobus' and Dwarf's argument event in the sewers then come back the next day

[spoiler][b]Spam[/b][/spoiler]
Befriend Darla to 4 hearts after seeing the Vincent and Jas sewer event in the forest (Must be Summer for Darla's event to trigger)

[spoiler][b]Marilda[/b][/spoiler]
- Date Maru and see her 10 heart event with the robot, come back the next day for another event (Marriage is NOT required. Debug ebi 10 if you don't want to date Maru but want this character to activate anyway. Then just come back the next day to see this characters intro event)


[b]Known Issues[/b]

- Dobson CANNOT sell you items despite what he may say (unless you have East Scarp's Juliet or another mod that changes the counter to always be active). But he's trying!
- Bebsi's shop freezes the screen when you exit the menu. Clicking anywhere should fix that.
- The bus interiors night tiles aren't working yet. But hey, there's a dirty and clean version that work as well as the different seasonal looks.
- Schedules outside of Spring and Summer are not currently implemented, and the Joja Route isn't implemented yet. (There's bound to be some issues with the community center route for a few characters)
- Liked and Disliked items are still a WIP. But each character should have a favorite of sorts
- portraits may not match festival appearances/not all festival appearances are implemented
- Darla will stand around for the egg festival instead of partaking
- Festival location placements for NPC's in Vanilla Stardew are off (will be fixed for next update)

[b]Compatibility
[/b]No longer compatible with multiplayer (I broke something, I'm not sure how to fix it I'm sorry!)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] is best recommended to go alongside this mod. But is no longer a hard requirement.
Should be compatible with most expansion mods?
Not compatible with SOME exterior bus mods (it'll work but it might look really funny on some of them).
NOT compatible with [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Aimon111?gameId=1303]Aimon[/url]'s bus interior mod
NOT compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/78813038]tikamin557[/url] Above Blacksmith is an Open Space mod
IS compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/217470318]awillowwisp[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36094]Riley[/url] mod
IS compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/197897369]HaruNesukts[/url]' [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31595]Desert Expansion[/url] mod (EDIT: Desert Expansion went through a massive change so there may be some visual bugs with compatibility)
